about.label: Viasat
about.summary: American satellite communications company headquartered in Carlsbad, California. The company provides satellite broadband and narrowband connectivity and communications equipment for commercial aviation, maritime, enterprise, consumer, military and government customers.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která provozuje satelity a nabízí satelitní internet a komunikaci pro letadla, lodě a armádu.

about.label: Match Group
about.summary: American internet and technology company headquartered in Dallas, Texas. It owns and operates the largest global portfolio of popular online dating services including Tinder, Match.com, Meetic, OkCupid, Hinge, Plenty of Fish, Azar, and other dating global brands.
about.summary_cs: Americká internetová firma, která provozuje největší seznamky na světě, mimo jiné Tinder, Hinge a Match.com.

about.label: Qorvo
about.summary: American multinational company specializing in products for wireless, wired, and power markets.
about.summary_cs: Americký výrobce čipů pro bezdrátovou komunikaci, hlavně pro mobilní telefony.

about.label: Paycom
about.summary: Online payroll and human resource software provider based in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, with offices throughout the United States.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která dodává online software pro mzdy a personalistiku.

about.label: Element Solutions
about.summary: American specialty chemicals production corporation listed on the New York Stock Exchange.
about.summary_cs: Americký výrobce speciálních chemikálií, hlavně pro elektroniku a průmyslové povrchové úpravy.

about.label: Ryman Hospitality Properties
about.summary: Hotel, resort, entertainment, and media company named for one of its assets: the Ryman Auditorium, a National Historic Landmark in Nashville, Tennessee. This purchase resulted in the ownership of the Grand Ole Opry and associated businesses, including the company's flagship resort property, then known as Opryland Hotel.
about.summary_cs: Americký realitní fond (REIT), který vlastní velké kongresové hotely a zábavní podniky v Nashvillu, včetně Grand Ole Opry.

about.label: CarMax
about.summary: Used vehicle retailer based in the United States. It operates two business segments: CarMax Sales Operations and CarMax Auto Finance.
about.summary_cs: Americký prodejce ojetých aut, který nabízí i financování jejich koupě.

about.label: Eastman Chemical Company
about.summary: American chemical products manufacturer based in Kingsport, Tennessee.

about.label: StoneX
about.summary: American financial services company. The company operates in six areas: commercial hedging, global payments, securities, physical commodities, foreign exchange and clearing and execution services.
about.summary_cs: Americká finanční firma, která nabízí zajištění proti cenovým výkyvům komodit, obchodování s cennými papíry a devizami a mezinárodní platby.

about.label: Victoria’s Secret
about.summary: American lingerie, clothing and beauty retailer.
about.summary_cs: Americký prodejce spodního prádla, oblečení a kosmetiky.

about.label: Armstrong World Industries
about.summary: International designer and manufacturer of wall and ceiling building materials based in Lancaster, Pennsylvania.
about.summary_cs: Výrobce stropních a stěnových stavebních materiálů se sídlem v Pensylvánii.

about.label: Alkermes
about.summary: Fully-integrated biopharmaceutical company that focuses on developing medicines for psychiatric and neurological disorders.
about.summary_cs: Biofarmaceutická firma, která vyvíjí léky na psychiatrická a neurologická onemocnění.

about.label: Matson, Inc.
about.summary: American ocean transportation and logistics company headquartered in Honolulu, Hawaii. Founded in 1882, Matson, Inc.'s subsidiary Matson Navigation Company provides ocean shipping services across the Pacific to Hawaii, Alaska, Guam, Micronesia, the Pacific islands, China, and Japan.
about.summary_cs: Americká lodní a logistická firma z Honolulu, která přepravuje zboží na Havaj, Aljašku a Guam a z Číny do USA.

about.label: PTC Therapeutics
about.summary: US pharmaceutical company focused on the development of orally administered small molecule drugs and gene therapy which regulate gene expression by targeting post-transcriptional control mechanisms in orphan diseases.
about.summary_cs: Americká farmaceutická firma, která vyvíjí léky na vzácná genetická onemocnění.
